description: This file defines attributes for implicit stream subscription in Orleans, including classes for annotation and filtering of streams based on namespace patterns or exact matches.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute used to mark grains with implicit stream subscriptions, supporting namespace filters and stream ID mappers.

classes.name: RegexImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Sealed attribute class for stream subscriptions filtered by regex pattern.

methods.name: ImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
methods.description: Constructors to initialize the attribute with various predicate options.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Generates binding properties for the grain's stream subscription, including handling legacy grain types.

methods.name: RegexImplicitStreamSubscriptionAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a regex pattern for stream namespace filtering.
